svg.data-source: NASA/JPL GPN-2000-001978 (1977, public domain), data/cover.json, Pioneer plaque vector map geometry
svg.title: Voyager Golden Record cover, rebuilt as exact layered SVG
svg.desc: The aluminium cover of the Voyager record, traced from the 1977 NASA photograph. Units are millimetres, origin at the top left of the 304.8 mm disc, orientation as in the photograph. Every binary digit is its own element (class bit one or bit zero, data-index) in document order, the most significant digit first as on the cover. Strokes are plain (currentColor); colour and lighting belong to the game.

circle.data-measured: disc edge fitted to the photo, rms 3.54 px

path.data-role: disc edge, hidden behind the cartridge

g.data-direction: counter-clockwise from the mark next to the cartridge
g.desc: Time for one turn of the record in hydrogen time units, written round the rim, read counter-clockwise from the mark next to the cartridge.
Playing time of one side in hydrogen time units, written in five rows between two tall bars.

g.data-role: general appearance of the video signal: burst, step, three lines

g.desc: Duration of one picture line in hydrogen time units, in three rows between two tall bars.

g.data-role: scan triggering: three slow downstrokes and fast retraces; the middle stroke carries its circles lower (staggered interlace)
video frame showing the direction of scan

g.data-layout: vertical notation: a horizontal bar then 5 dashes (left column, bottom to top) and 4 dashes (right column, bottom to top)
g.desc: Number of vertical lines in one picture (512) in vertical notation.

g.data-role: the first image: a circle in a frame, fixing the ratio of horizontal to vertical
the pulsar map: the Sun at the origin, 14 pulsars and the galactic centre
distance to the galactic centre, R0, the unit of the map
the two lowest states of the hydrogen atom and the transition between them
